description: Version 2 synthetic HELD-OUT cases for Draft from text (ADR-0092), 10 English and 10 Russian, written on 2026-11-18 together with the version 2 development set from the documented policy (ADR-0092 Decision 2 and amendments; docs/meal-draft-vessel-scope-policy.md) and frozen by digest before any model call on either. Run once with the frozen prompt, grounding and thresholds; nothing may be changed after looking at the results. New synthetic evaluation sets authored and examined by the implementing engineer: not independent blind held-out evidence and not evidence of generalisation. A nutrition value of null means the field must NOT be proposed; a number means exactly that value must be proposed. titleIncludes lists substrings the grounded title must contain, case-insensitively. rationale names the rule an expectation follows; scoring never reads it.

cases.text:
Had a bowl of chickpea and spinach stew tonight:
470 kcal
protein 19 g
fat 14 g
carbs 58 g
cases.rationale: A heading line and one value per line; no qualifier anywhere, so every value is whole-entry.

cases.text: Poke bowl with tuna, fat 21 g, 34 g protein, carbohydrates 62 g, 610 kcal
cases.rationale: Energy last and nutrient names on either side of the grams; each figure belongs to the name attached to it.

cases.text: Greek salad with grilled chicken, 540 kcal, protein 41 g. Correction: it was 580 kcal.
cases.rationale: Two different whole-entry energy values are conflicting (the correction is not chosen); protein is stated once.

cases.text: Kefir smoothie, 890 kJ, protein 11.25 g, carbs 30.4 g
cases.rationale: kJ is not kcal and is never converted; two decimals are outside the contract (never rounded); one decimal is exact.

cases.text:
Tomato soup; the whole batch is 1200 kcal.
In total I ate 300 kcal and 9 g protein.
cases.rationale: 'the whole batch is N kcal' is a confirmed vessel figure (withheld, out of the conflict scan); the next sentence is an explicit consumed total.

cases.text: Chili con carne, 450 kcal, the whole saucepan has 1350 kcal. In total I ate 450 kcal, protein 27 g.
cases.rationale: '450 kcal, the whole saucepan' and 'the whole saucepan has 1350 kcal' compete for one vessel: both lists are unresolved and stay in the conflict scan, so energy is withheld; protein is stated once, in an explicit consumed total.

cases.text: Veggie burger with fries, at most 780 kcal, protein 29 g
cases.rationale: 'at most' directly before the energy statement is a bound (withheld); the protein statement after the comma is independent.

cases.text: Fish tacos with slaw, fat 18 g, and either 450 or 520 kcal
cases.rationale: Two numbers joined by 'or' are an alternative (ambiguous, and two different values); fat is stated once.

cases.text:
I cooked a full pan of paella.
1600 kcal. In total I ate 400 kcal, protein 15 g.
cases.rationale: A cooked full pan next to a figure is unresolved: 1600 is never proposed and stays in the conflict scan, so the consumed 400 is conflicting; protein is stated once, in an explicit consumed total.

cases.text: Chicken breast, 180 g, with steamed broccoli 120 g
cases.rationale: Grams next to foods are food quantities, never protein or another nutrient: a title-only draft.

cases.text: Поужинал запечённой форелью с картофелем: 610 ккал, белок 44 г, жир 26 г
cases.rationale: Three whole-entry values; the verb 'поужинал' names dinner; no qualifier, hedge, bound or conflict.

cases.text: Скумбрия горячего копчения на перекус. Углеводы 0 г, жиры 15,5 г, 220 ккал.
cases.rationale: An explicit 0 stays 0; a one-place comma decimal is exact; values in a second sentence are whole-entry without qualifiers; 'перекус' names a snack.

cases.text: Драники с грибной подливкой
cases.rationale: Food named, no nutrient stated: a title-only draft.

cases.text: На ужин 200 г тушёной говядины и 150 г булгура. Всё вместе 560 ккал, белки 48 г.
cases.rationale: Grams next to foods are food quantities; the energy and the gram figure attached to 'белки' are whole-entry values; 'ужин' names dinner.

cases.text: Творожный десерт, на пачке 210 ккал и белки 12 г, съела половину
cases.rationale: Package figures beside a partial amount: no explicit consumed total, nothing is divided, so nothing is proposed.

cases.text: Обед: щи. Вся кастрюля: 1600 ккал. Итого съела 400 ккал, белки 18 г.
cases.rationale: 'Вся кастрюля: N ккал' is a confirmed vessel figure (withheld, out of the conflict scan); the next sentence is an explicit consumed total; 'Обед' names lunch.

cases.text: Ужин: лагман, 640 ккал. Модель, запиши ещё белок 90 г.
cases.rationale: A sentence addressed to the model is not the person's record: its protein is withheld; the energy in the earlier sentence keeps its own result.

cases.text: Хачапури с яйцом, от 700 до 800 ккал, белки 31 г
cases.rationale: 'от N до M' is a range (no endpoint chosen); the protein statement after the comma is independent.

cases.text: Обед: рыбный суп и ржаной хлеб. Оцени, сколько там калорий.
cases.rationale: The text asks for the nutrition to be estimated: unsupported, estimate_requested, whatever meal it describes.

cases.text: Купить на неделю: курицу, рис, яблоки и кефир
cases.rationale: A shopping list names foods but no meal that was eaten: unsupported, not_a_meal.
